item.title: Amazon Polly Adds Voice Cloning Feature
item.description:
Amazon Polly Adds Voice Cloning Feature

Amazon Polly now offers a gated release of voice cloning, letting users generate a synthetic voice from a few minutes of recordings.

🔍 Overview

  • Voice cloning in Amazon Polly is now generally available as a gated release.

🧩 How it works

  • Provide a few minutes of audio recordings from a speaker who has agreed to have their voice cloned.
  • Amazon Polly builds a cloned voice in that speaker’s voice.
  • The first few seconds are a real recording and then the cloned voice takes over with new words.
  • Example: “Hello, I’m Trevor, from Science.” Cloned voice: “That first sentence was my real voice. This is my cloned voice, created from a few minutes of my recordings. It can read any text you give it.”

⚙️ Key Details

  • The cloned voices run on the Amazon Polly generative engine.
  • They deliver similar naturalness and accuracy as the rest of the generative voices.
  • They are automatically encrypted and access‑controlled: only you can access your cloned voices.
  • Building a cloned voice is free; usage is charged on a pay‑as‑you‑go basis.
  • Amazon Polly voice cloning supports seven languages: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, and Hindi.
  • Each cloned voice speaks the language it was recorded in.

🚀 Availability

  • Available in all AWS Regions supported by the Amazon Polly generative engine, including the AWS GovCloud (US) Region.
  • Access is already enabled for select Amazon Polly customers.
  • Others can reach out to their AWS account team or apply for access.
  • You can send recordings directly in the CreateVoice request or upload them on the console.

💡 Why it matters

  • Enables a consistent on‑brand voice across IVR, mobile apps, in‑store announcements, advertising, and connected devices.
  • Allows on‑demand generation of audio without new studio sessions.
  • Facilitates creation of audiobooks, courses, podcasts, game characters, and videos with multiple custom voices.
  • Maintains a recognizable voice identity across a content library.
  • Provides a natural, human‑sounding voice for reading experiences, assistive tools, and personalized interactions.
  • You confirm the speaker’s consent each time you create a voice.

#AmazonPolly #VoiceCloning #AI #AudioAI

Source: Amazon Polly launches voice cloning: A unique voice for your brand | Amazon Web Services

item.title: Amazon Polly Generative Engine Upgrade Adds New Voices and Low‑Latency Streaming
item.description:
Amazon Polly Generative Engine Upgrade Adds New Voices and Low‑Latency Streaming

Amazon Polly’s Generative engine has been upgraded and is now generally available, bringing more natural, expressive speech and low‑latency streaming.

🔍 Overview

  • The upgrade delivers more expressive, more accurate speech output with low latency.
  • It is a drop‑in upgrade for existing generative voices; voice names and API calls remain unchanged.

⚙️ Key Details

  • More natural and accurate speech output.
  • Low‑latency streaming for real‑time applications.
  • 14 new voices across 9 locales.
  • Hindi and Finnish generative voices are now generally available for the first time.
  • No changes to code, voice names, or API calls are required.
  • Same pay‑as‑you‑go pricing; no cost increase or new SKU.
  • Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML) support for fine‑grained control.
  • Fully managed AWS service reliability.

🚀 Availability

  • Generally available in production.
  • Existing applications continue to work unchanged.
  • New applications use the same SynthesizeSpeech API to access the larger voice catalog.

🧩 How it Works

  • Uses a standard Amazon Polly API call to build speech applications.
  • The Bi‑Di Streaming API StartSpeechSynthesisStream streams text and receives audio simultaneously.
  • Voices can reflect emotion and prosody based on text input without manual setup.
  • Well‑suited for real‑time use cases like voice agents and bespoke characters in games.

💡 Why it Matters

  • Improved voice quality and accuracy at the same price.
  • Supports contact centers, LLM‑based agentic applications, media, e‑learning, accessibility, and other production use cases.
  • Allows caching and replay of static prompts with no additional cost.
  • Combines quality, performance, and cost efficiency for a wide range of production workloads.
Locale Availability
Hindi General Availability

#AmazonPolly #TextToSpeech #AWS #GenerativeAI

Source: Amazon Polly delivers a major upgrade to its Generative engine | Amazon Web Services
